Sets up and runs bundle, sign, and metric tiles in isolation.

# Purpose
This file defines the `bundle-client` action for `fdctl`. It builds a small topology that runs the `bundle`, `sign`, and `metric` tiles in one process, then starts that topology and keeps the process alive with `pause()`. The code uses `fd_topob_*` functions to create the topology, add workspaces, define tiles, define links, and connect tile inputs and outputs. It also sets tile parameters from `config_t`, such as the bundle URL, TLS SNI, identity key path, buffer sizes, keepalive interval, and Prometheus listen address and port.

The file also defines the command entry points [`bundle_client_cmd_args`](<#bundle_client_cmd_args>) and [`bundle_client_cmd_fn`](<#bundle_client_cmd_fn>), and exports the `action_t` object `fd_action_bundle_client`. The command has no extra arguments, marks itself as a diagnostic action, and is intended to run the bundle tile in isolation against a live cluster.
